title: Implement session-local Ozi auto mode and builder-focused status
description: Replace shared project-wide Ozi auto-dispatch control with session-local runtime state so builder sessions can auto-implement without forcing frontier/planning sessions into auto mode. Simplify Ozi status output in auto mode to focus on ready queue, claimed work, and dispatch activity.
non_goals: Do not implement global shared auto mode as the primary control path
Do not auto-dispatch implementation lugs without explicit approval
Do not broaden into daemon orchestration in this batch
verification_requirements: Verify auto mode is keyed to session-local runtime rather than shared WAI-State.json
Verify wai_ozi.py shows builder-focused output when auto mode is on
Verify control skills exist for on/off/status/parallel without ozi prefix
Verify concurrent sessions can read the shared queue without sharing auto mode state

progress: ✅ Replaced shared auto mode control with session-local runtime files under WAI-Spoke/runtime/ozi-sessions/
✅ Reworked wai_ozi.py to key auto mode by session identifier (ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME / WT_SESSION / WAI_OZI_SESSION_KEY)
✅ Simplified Ozi auto mode output to ready queue, claimed work, and recent dispatch activity
✅ Verified auto mode claims work with owner ozi:cubic-river and logs session_key in changelog

commands: python3 wai_ozi.py after enabling session-local config
tests_run.notes: Interactive mode shows normal briefing; auto mode shows builder-focused queue and claims eligible work for current session only.

checks.requirement: Verify auto mode is keyed to session-local runtime rather than shared WAI-State.json
checks.evidence: wai_ozi.py session_key() derives key from WAI_OZI_SESSION_KEY/ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME/WT_SESSION env vars; runtime config stored at WAI-Spoke/runtime/ozi-sessions/<session-key>.json; no WAI-State.json reads for auto mode

checks.requirement: Verify wai_ozi.py shows builder-focused output when auto mode is on
checks.evidence: _generate_auto_mode_briefing() shows READY TO WORK, CLAIMED BY THIS SESSION, RECENT DISPATCH ACTIVITY sections only — no broad user-interaction content

checks.requirement: Verify control skills exist for on/off/status/parallel without ozi prefix
checks.evidence: templates/commands/wai-auto-on.md, wai-auto-off.md, wai-auto-status.md, wai-auto-parallel.md all present; identical copies in WAI-Spoke/commands/

checks.requirement: Verify concurrent sessions can read the shared queue without sharing auto mode state
checks.evidence: WAI-Lugs.jsonl is shared/read-only for queue scan; auto mode is per-session file in runtime/ozi-sessions/<key>.json; cubic-river.json sample confirmed session-isolated state

verification_record.notes: All four verification requirements pass. Session-local isolation confirmed in code and runtime artifact. Builder-focused output branch confirmed. All four control skills present in both templates and spoke.
